details: 2013 · not checked · MED · Jhon Edgar Amaya, Carlos Cotta and Antonio J. Fernández-Leiva. International Journal of Computational Intelligence Systems 6(3). title: Greedy Randomized Adaptive Search Procedures
details: 1995 · not checked · MED · Thomas A. Feo and Mauricio G. C. Resende. Journal of Global Optimization 6. [Author full text](https://mauricio.resende.info/doc/gtut.pdf). · Foundation, sections 1 and 2: incremental randomized construction followed by improvement in a chosen neighborhood. Set-covering and maximum-independent-set examples. A partial-team scoring heuristic still needs validation.

title: Search trajectory networks: A tool for analysing and visualising the behaviour of metaheuristics
details: 2021 · not checked · MED · Gabriela Ochoa, Katherine M. Malan and Christian Blum. Applied Soft Computing 109, 107492. [Accepted manuscript](https://www.storre.stir.ac.uk/bitstream/1893/32613/1/stns_asoc_2021.pdf). [Author code](https://github.com/gabro8a/STNs). · First landscape read. Sections 3 and 5 use actual search traces and a fixed-cardinality p-median case. Reuse candidate identities and transitions where logged; visited trajectories do not map the entire landscape or prove a win-rate improvement.

title: Local Optima Networks: A New Model of Combinatorial Fitness Landscapes
details: 2014 · not checked · MED · Gabriela Ochoa, Sébastien Verel, Fabio Daolio and Marco Tomassini. Chapter in Recent Advances in the Theory and Application of Fitness Landscapes. [Publisher DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-642-41888-4_9). · Foundation for optima, basins and escape transitions, with quadratic-assignment and NK examples. Metadata and abstract verified. VGC needs an explicit legal neighborhood and uncertainty-qualified local-optimum claims; basin sampling can consume many battles.

title: Exploratory Landscape Analysis for Mixed-Variable Problems
details: 2024 · not checked · MED · Raphael Patrick Prager and Heike Trautmann. IEEE Transactions on Evolutionary Computation, first online 2024, final issue 29(4) in 2025. [Publisher DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/TEVC.2024.3399560). · Later methodology for mixed continuous, integer and categorical features and algorithm selection on hyperparameter tasks. Species IDs are not meaningful numeric distances. Requires VGC feature, sampling-cost and held-out selector validation.
